title: Investigation of Interaction between SARS-CoV-2 Spike Protein and ACE2-Expressing Cells
author: Shang, Chen, et al.
materials: ALL cell lines used in this study were purchased from the Cell Bank of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (Shanghai, China). HEK293T (human, kidney), Huh-7 (human, liver), MRC-5 (human, lung), U251M (human, brain) cells were cultured in DMEM (Dulbecco’s’ modified Eagle medium) (Hyclone), H1299 AND H460 (human, lung) cells were cultured in RPMI-1640(Hyclone), MRC5(human, lung) and HepG2 (human, lung) cells were cultured in MEM (Minimum Essential Medium, Gibco) at 37 °C and 5% CO2 in a humidified atmosphere, supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and penicillin (100 μg/ml), streptomycin sulfate (100 μg/ ml), 1x non-essential amino acid solution (10x stock, PAA) and 10 mM sodium pyruvate (ThermoFisher Scientific). For normal seeding and subcultivation, cells were first washed with phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and then incubated in the presence of trypsin/EDTA solution (Cytiva) until the cells detached. For capturing, cells were detached with Enzyme-Free Cell Dissociation Solution (ThermoFisher).

Total RNA of 293 T, Huh7, HepG2, H1299, H460, U251 and MRC5 cells were isolated using TransZol Up plus RNA Kit (TIANGEN). cDNA synthesized through a PrimeScript RT reagent Kit with gDNA Eraser (TaKaRa) and using random hexamers as primers (42 °C for 2 min, 37 °C for 15 min, 85 °C for 5 s). Forward primer GACAAGAGCAAACGGTTGAACAC and reverse primer GCCCAGAGCCTCTCATTGTAG were used for the qRT-PCR for ACE2. Genes were analyzed using Realstar Green Fast Mixture UNG with ROX (GenStar A305–05) on a LightCycler 480 Real-Time PCR system (Roche). Internal H1299 mRNA levels were used for normalization and the fold expression was calculated using the 2−ΔCT method compared to the 293 T, Huh7, HepG2, H1299, H460, U251, MRC5 cells mRNA levels.

ACE2-GFP transfected HEK293T cell at 70% confluent were washed with PBS, fixed for 10 min with cold 100% methanol, and blocked using 5% BSA in PBS for 2 h. Subsequently, cells were incubated with a 1:2000 diluted anti-ACE2 rabbit polyclonal (10108-T24, Sino Biological) overnight at 4 °C, washed with PBS and incubated for 2 h with Alexa 488-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG antibody (Invitrogen). After staining, slides were mounted using ProLong Antifade (Thermo Fisher) solution and observed using a Leica SP8 confocal microscope.

steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate growth medium for each cell line: DMEM (Hyclone) for HEK293T, Huh‑7, MRC‑5, U251M; RPMI‑1640 (Hyclone) for H1299 and H460; MEM (Gibco) for MRC5 and HepG2. Supplement all media with 10 % fetal bovine serum, penicillin 100 µg ml⁻¹, streptomycin sulfate 100 µg ml⁻¹, 1× non‑essential amino acid solution (10× stock, PAA) and 10 mM sodium pyruvate (ThermoFisher). Culture cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified incubator.

steps.title: Detach cells for subcultivation
steps.instruction: Wash adherent cells with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), then add trypsin/EDTA solution (Cytiva) and incubate until cells detach.

steps.title: Detach cells for capture assays
steps.instruction: Wash cells with PBS and detach them using Enzyme‑Free Cell Dissociation Solution (ThermoFisher).

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from 293T, Huh7, HepG2, H1299, H460, U251 and MRC5 cells using the TransZol Up Plus RNA Kit (TIANGEN) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe RNA with PrimeScript RT reagent Kit with gDNA Eraser (TaKaRa) using random hexamers, following the temperature program: 42 °C for 2 min, 37 °C for 15 min, then 85 °C for 5 s.

steps.title: Perform quantitative PCR
steps.instruction: Set up qRT‑PCR reactions with Realstar Green Fast Mixture UNG with ROX (GenStar A305‑05) on a LightCycler 480 (Roche) using 10 µl of cDNA, forward primer GACAAGAGCAAACGGTTGAACAC and reverse primer GCCCAGAGCCTCTCATTGTAG. Run the assay according to the instrument’s recommended cycling conditions.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Normalize ACE2 expression to internal H1299 mRNA levels and calculate fold change using the 2⁻ΔCT method, comparing each cell line to the 293T, Huh7, HepG2, H1299, H460, U251 and MRC5 samples.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining
steps.instruction: Stain ACE2‑GFP‑transfected HEK293T cells (70 % confluent) for confocal imaging.

substeps.instruction: Fix with cold 100 % methanol for 10 min.
Block with 5 % BSA in PBS for 2 h at room temperature.
Incubate with anti‑ACE2 rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:2000, 10108‑T24, Sino Biological) overnight at 4 °C.
Incubate with Alexa 488‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG (Invitrogen) for 2 h at room temperature.
Wash and mount slides with ProLong Antifade (Thermo Fisher).
Image using a Leica SP8 confocal microscope.

steps.title: Immunize mice with spike protein
steps.instruction: Inject eight‑week‑old female BALB/c mice subcutaneously with 50 µg SARS‑CoV‑2 spike protein (40607‑V08B, Sino Biological) emulsified in incomplete Freund’s adjuvant (CFA), using a volume of ≤100 µl per injection site.

steps.title: Boost mouse immunizations
steps.instruction: At 2 weeks and 4 weeks after the initial injection, boost the same mice with spike protein emulsified in incomplete Freund’s adjuvant (IFA) using the same dose and volume.

steps.title: Collect and test serum
steps.instruction: Harvest serum from immunized and control mice, dilute at least 1:100, and assess anti‑spike antibody levels by ELISA.
